items.title: GameStop Stock (GME) Has 4 Reasons to Rally Beyond Its Meme-Stock Fame
items.summary: GameStop (GME), Wall Street’s most famous meme stock, is giving investors more reasons to take its fundamentals seriously. The stock has gained more than 30% in 2026, and it’s not just speculation. The retailer saw its operating profit jump 141% last quarter, even as sales fell nearly 19%. Under Ryan Cohen’s direction, GameStop accumulated a nearly $5 billion stake in eBay (EBAY), while Cohen personally bought about $119 million worth of GameStop stock this year.
